stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: His inability to lift the crate made him ask for help.
items.sentenceZh: 他搬不动箱子，于是请求帮助。
items.scene: An adult unable to lift a heavy wooden crate, hands under its edges and strained full face, colleague approaches to help; crate remains firmly on ground, no text.
items.altText: 男子尝试搬起沉重木箱，吃力地向走来的同伴求助。

items.sentenceEn: She looked troubled after seeing the damaged garden.
items.sentenceZh: 看到受损的花园后，她显得忧心忡忡。
items.scene: An adult woman with a clearly troubled full face surveys broken pots and wind-damaged flowers in a traditional Chinese courtyard garden, no injuries or text.
items.altText: 女子望着中式庭院里破损的花盆和花枝，满脸忧虑。

items.sentenceEn: The tiny umbrella was inadequate for the two hikers.
items.sentenceZh: 这把小伞不足以为两名徒步者遮雨。
items.scene: Two adult hikers huddle under an obviously too-small umbrella during rain, uncovered shoulders wet, full rueful faces, umbrella covers only their heads partly, no lettering.
items.altText: 两名徒步者挤在过小的伞下，肩膀仍被雨淋湿。

items.sentenceEn: His muddy boots were inappropriate for the clean tea room.
items.sentenceZh: 他的泥靴不适合穿进干净的茶室。
items.scene: An adult visitor pauses outside a pristine Chinese tea room noticing his muddy hiking boots, full embarrassed face, host gently offers clean slippers at doorway, no footprints inside or written signs.
items.altText: 访客在洁净茶室门口看着泥靴，主人递来拖鞋。

items.sentenceEn: She placed a flower in the twentieth pot.
items.sentenceZh: 她在第二十个花盆里放了一朵花。
items.scene: Strict overhead view of exactly twenty small identical terracotta pots arranged in exactly two rows of ten. Nineteen pots contain green seedlings; only the last pot at far right of bottom row contains a single red flower. No additional pots, numbers, labels or people.
items.altText: 两排各十个花盆，最后一盆放着红花，其余盆里是绿苗。

items.sentenceEn: The balanced tray stayed level in her hands.
items.sentenceZh: 托盘在她手中保持平衡和水平。
items.scene: An adult server carries a perfectly level wooden tea tray with evenly spaced ceramic teacups in a Chinese garden pavilion, full careful face, natural hands supporting sides, no spilling or text.
items.altText: 园亭里的女子双手稳稳端着水平茶盘。

items.sentenceEn: The judge decided to incarcerate the convicted thief.
items.sentenceZh: 法官决定监禁被定罪的小偷。
items.scene: A convicted adult thief escorted through an open barred prison door by an officer, sparse cell ahead, complete solemn faces, no weapons physical violence written verdict or insignia.
items.altText: 警员陪同被定罪的男子走进有铁栏门的监室。

items.sentenceEn: The foreigner asked a local guide about the old temple.
items.sentenceZh: 外国游客向当地向导询问古庙。
items.scene: An adult overseas tourist holding a plain folded map asks a Chinese local guide about an old temple, full curious faces, travel pack, temple gateway visible, no flags nationality stereotypes or readable map text.
items.altText: 海外游客在古庙前拿着地图向当地向导请教。

items.sentenceEn: During his incarceration, he spent time reading.
items.sentenceZh: 监禁期间，他花时间读书。
items.scene: An adult prisoner reads quietly on a bunk inside a modest barred cell, fully rendered thoughtful face, open book with blank pages, no lettering, no officer or active violence.
items.altText: 监室里的男子坐在床上安静读书。

items.sentenceEn: The drawer was open about an inch.
items.sentenceZh: 抽屉打开了大约一英寸。
items.scene: Close view of a small wooden drawer pulled open by only a very narrow gap around one inch, familiar metal handle for scale, no ruler labels numbers text or people; sentence supplies imperial measurement.
items.altText: 小木抽屉只打开一条很窄的缝隙。

items.meaningZh: 方便；便利的事物；方便的时候
items.sentenceEn: The nearby shop offered the convenience of a short walk.
items.sentenceZh: 附近的小店让购物只需走一小段路。
items.scene: A Chinese neighborhood courtyard home and nearby grocery shop connected by a very short clear footpath, adult resident carrying a small basket arrives easily, full face, no signs labels or text.
items.altText: 住户提着篮子沿短路走到邻近的小店。

items.sentenceEn: The incidence of damaged leaves fell after the pests were removed.
items.sentenceZh: 除去害虫后，受损叶片的发生率下降了。
items.scene: Two panels of same garden plant: left many leaves with chewed holes and small insects, right mostly intact fresh leaves and no insects, visibly lower incidence of damage, no numbers arrows labels or human faces.
items.altText: 同一植物的对比画面由多片虫咬叶子变为多数完好叶子。

items.sentenceEn: The child's delight was clear when the kite rose.
items.sentenceZh: 风筝升起时，孩子的喜悦显而易见。
items.scene: A child beams with delight as a bright kite rises into a clear sky, full excited face, natural hands holding kite spool, a caring adult watches, no text or logos.
items.altText: 孩子看着风筝升上天空，开心地笑着。

items.sentenceEn: The gardener was inclined to choose the sunny spot.
items.sentenceZh: 园丁倾向于选择向阳的位置。
items.scene: An adult gardener considers two empty planting beds and leans toward the one in bright sun, shaded bed also visible, full thoughtful face, gestures clearly toward sunny location, no arrows words.
items.altText: 园丁比较阴处和阳处的花床，倾向选择向阳的一侧。

items.sentenceEn: A small brush was included in the painting kit.
items.sentenceZh: 绘画套装里包含一支小画笔。
items.scene: Open compact painting kit holding watercolor pans and one clearly fitted small brush in its own recess, plain blank lid, no other unrelated tools, no text or people.
items.altText: 打开的绘画套装中，颜料旁专门放着一支小画笔。

items.sentenceEn: She learned to weave a basket from bamboo strips.
items.sentenceZh: 她学着用竹条编篮子。
items.scene: An adult craftswoman weaves crossing bamboo strips into a partly completed basket in a Chinese craft workshop, full concentrated face, clear interlacing and natural hands, no writing.
items.altText: 工坊中的女子把竹条交错编成篮子。

items.sentenceEn: The ramp made the inclusion of wheelchair users possible.
items.sentenceZh: 坡道让轮椅使用者也能参与。
items.scene: A wheelchair user joins friends inside a community hall through a broad accessible ramp, full welcoming faces, no symbolic inclusion badges signs text or tokenizing pose.
items.altText: 轮椅使用者沿坡道进入社区活动厅，与朋友相聚。

items.sentenceEn: The carpenter stacked the timber beside the workshop.
items.sentenceZh: 木匠把木材堆放在工坊旁。
items.scene: Neatly stacked sawn timber boards and squared wood beams beside a rustic workshop, visible end grain and varied lengths, no people writing or unsafe leaning stacks.
items.altText: 工坊旁整齐堆放着木板和方木，端面木纹清晰。

items.sentenceEn: The incorrect piece did not fit the puzzle.
items.sentenceZh: 错误的拼图块无法嵌入拼图。
items.scene: Natural hand holds one puzzle piece next to final hole of nearly completed geometric puzzle, piece outline unmistakably incompatible with hole, no words numbers or faces.
items.altText: 手拿着形状不匹配的拼图块，无法放进最后空位。

items.sentenceEn: She waited till the rain stopped before leaving.
items.sentenceZh: 她等到雨停后才离开。
items.scene: Two panels same adult and same doorway: left person waits indoors while rain falls outside, right same person steps outside after rain has stopped and clouds break, full faces, no text clock or arrows.
items.altText: 女子先在门内等雨，雨停后才走出门。
